label: copy phase: fed-back input a/q while outputting a/q (later positions)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and essentially only when the fed-back input token is a or q (in_tok in {a,q} gives recall 1.00 but precision 0.05). Never fires in the original or delimiter phase or on any other input token. Activation is strongest when the token being output is also a or q (out_tok a 23x, q 18x lift; top examples are q->a, a->a, q->q pairs such as ...x q a a with output a) and grows with copy position (recall_idx >= 3, late t, long L=9 sequences). Weaker activations occur with input a/q and some other output (0, f, c...). It is mostly silent on a/q inputs at early recall positions (recall_idx 0-2). The conjunction of a/q input, a/q output and recall_idx >= 3 reaches dev F1 0.65 and mass recall 0.77. Precision and recall are both clearly incomplete because magnitude is graded.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: a, q, -, c, f, z; least: r, h, m, <DEL>) and the token being output (most: a, q, 0, f, c, y; least: -, r, 2, h); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=10, L=9 & t=15, L=9 & t=14.
